entity.name: La Frase Inconclusa
entity.role: The user's verbal/semiotic adversary manifests as ghost knights, each embodying a different abuse of meaning.
entity.ontology: Manifestation is observable; whether it is a soul, relic-mediated apparition or autonomous language is unresolved. It cannot rewrite canonical past events.
entity.shared_goal: Convert uncertain interpretations into uncontestable obligations.
entity.soul_conflict: Tries to replace the consent of a fragmented artifact soul with the correct-looking formula. Only actual locally verified persuasion permits assembly.

turn_contract.clock: Only committing a complete world turn advances knights. Typing, language corrections, inspecting and pausing do not.

snapshot_rules.knight_perception: Current location plus adjacent discovered locations; traces of previous turns only.

turn_contract.movement: Each actor spends its own daily movement allowance on one queued route. Resolve route edges in ticks. New allies, loot and buffs take effect next turn.

collisions.same_destination: Encounter at destination; no actor takes a second order.
collisions.opposite_edges: Encounter on the shared edge; neither phases through the other.
collisions.multiple_knights: Select one encounter by fixed initiative then ID; other knights spend their order guarding, no extra fights.
collisions.player_counter_same_target: Valid evidence counter interrupts that intervention; failed counter does not erase stored evidence.

knights.name: El Glosador
knights.appearance: Серые латы покрыты живыми полями рукописи; говорит уточнениями.
knights.method: Изменяет смысл подписи, добавляя правдоподобную оговорку.

orders.target_selection: Highest policy score among perceived eligible targets; tie by stable target ID.

intervention.trace: La etiqueta nueva añade una palabra que no aparece en el original.

counter.description_ru: Сравнить новую подпись с сохранённым оригиналом.
counter.failure: Offer a clue and a simpler supported reply within the current block; do not remove evidence.

battle.defeat: Disperse for three world turns and cancel this knight's active local effect; do not grant truth or soul consent.
battle.retreat: Keep equipment, clues and consent; local effect may continue only to its fixed expiry.
